title: Certify ite terms over the uninterpreted sort in QF_UF refutations
summary: The QF_UF certificate slice now accepts ite terms whose branches have the uninterpreted sort, rendering them as Lean's ite over the carrier type with Lean-checked gate clauses, and fixes two older clause-log replay gaps (condition-free Boolean ite gates and the last-resort cnf lemma) exposed by random nested-ite inputs. All 28 gating CI checks passed in one round and the reviewer approved with three nits, one fixed.
